params.title: Cost allocations
params.description: How each employee's wage costs are split over cost centres and projects. Without a split, the costs go to the cost centre of the employee's department.

params.title: Cost allocation
params.note: payroll-cost-allocation (2026-09-30): one employee's split of wage costs over cost centres and projects, fixed in percentages or by the approved hours booked. CostAllocationGuardListener refuses a fixed split that does not add up to 100 percent and a split that overlaps another of the same employee. Every payroll calculation reads it (CostAllocationService) and writes the payslip's WageCostAllocation lines.

params.title: Wage costs
params.description: The wage costs of every payslip per cost centre and project, as the payroll journal books them. Filter on a period to see one month; the payroll run page shows the total per cost centre.

params.title: Wage cost line
params.note: payroll-cost-allocation (2026-09-30): one line of a payslip's wage costs on one cost centre and project. The payroll run writes and replaces these after every calculation (CostAllocationService), so every field is read-only here; the payroll journal books its debit lines per cost centre from them.
